name: Draconic Wing Buffet (Combat)
body:
Your draconic wings can be used as weapons in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrager or sorcerer with the draconic bloodline, base attack bonus +7, wings or draconic wings class feature, Draconic Manifestation, Draconic Tail.

Benefit(s): Whenever you manifest your wings and are wearing no armor or light armor, you also gain two wing buffet attacks. These are secondary attacks that deal 1d4 damage (1d3 if you are Small), plus ½ your Strength modifier. You cannot use your wing attacks while flying.
